content: बीजिन् {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) .²1 Possessed of seed, bearing seed. .²2 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Of the seed or blood of. --{%m.%} .²1 The real father or progenitor (sower of seed) (<ab>opp.</ab> क्षोत्रिन् the owner or husband of the क्षेत्र or woman); see <ls>Ms. 9. 51</ls> {%et seq.%} .²2 A father in general. .²3 The sun.
